title: Are You a Lion or a Donkey?
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum! Yaa Rabbee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah!
Allah!!! Zid mubarak, yaa Rabbee! Zidhu `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah,
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah,
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah,
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, SubhaanAllah! 2x
Subhaanak yaa Rabbana. Nahnu `abeeduk yaa Rabbana khalaqtana wa ...... ataytana min kulli shay'in wa ma
kuna mawjoodin anta awjadtana wa khalaqtana. Yaa Rabbana...waslih shaanana wa shaan al muslimoon! Yaa
ayyuha 'l- ghafiloon! Mashaa-Allah, subhanAllah, just they have been sent from up.

O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. They are hoping for something, therefore, they are coming and we
are welcoming them. And I am asking, for what are you coming? "We are coming for visiting, shum al-hawaa,
to smell the air." So many people are coming for enjoying; they heard there is some person at the end of the
world sitting on an island, saying, “He is the weakest servant on Earth; we must go, because if he is the
weakest one, he is giving what he has been granted from heavenly powers, giving so that he is becoming
weak.” As you like: payment or no payment, it is free! People asking for freedom come here. If anyone is
asking for freedom, they may find freedom in the jungle, not in the cities. But now it is changed and people
are saying, "We must be free ones, like jungle people." If you are asking to be free like jungle people, go to the
jungle, why are you coming here?! Go to Africa! Yes, America is also a jungle! "We are asking for another kind
freedom." When you get your free will in your hands, then you shall be free. As long as your ego is making
you its ride, you can't be a free one.
One waliullah said to me, "O Shaykh! Do you know how many kinds of people are living on Earth?"
I answered, “So many kinds."
He said, "No, two kinds! You must know what I am saying."
A big saint said, "Mankind are from two kinds: one is under the flag of Mankind riding on their rides (egos);
and the second kind is not like the first group, although they are both like animals, but one is not harming
anything, and the second group are wild ones, harming others. Those in the first group are very tame, very
soft and good ones, and the second kind are so wild and terrible, always attacking each other and aggressive!
Mostly if you are coming from the front they bite you, and if you are coming from behind, they kick you. Be
far away from them!” SubhaanAllah! He continued, "In general, Mankind has been granted a ride to ride
on, according to their Creation's hikmat, wisdom. Everyone is just created by some wisdom and you can't find
everyone in nature to the same. But generally, some peoples' characteristics are different from another group.
One group of Mankind is very, very soft. Everyone is representing one from the animals’ world. Mostly people
are of two kinds, and of them some are the level of donkeys, and people ride on them. And now the whole
world is in such a way because people left Shari`atullah, the holy orders of Allah Almighty that He granted
them to be honored ones. Now they are falling down, behaving like donkeys, and people are riding on them.”
That waliullah said that classification of people represent donkeys' group among animals. Understanding?
There are always donkeys riding on them and they are unhappy. They are Shaytan's donkeys because they are

followers of Shaytan and its group! Shaytan is from the wild kind, because when Allah Almighty ordered
angels to bow to Adam and all angels fell into sajdah, only Shaytan refused, saying, "No! I am not making
sajdah for that one. O Lord of Creation (not, 'O my Lord')! You are making them more honorable than me,
when, for thousands and thousands of years, I made sajdah to You! But You are not granting me that honor;
rather, You are giving it to that new one who is not making sajdah like me! Therefore, I will not obey that
order!"
Allah Almighty is not in need to address such a dirty creature, haasha! Angels were saying, "Bow! Go away
dirty one!" And Shaytan said, "I will make (Mankind) my donkeys. I am not leaving one of them to be free but
I will ride on him!"
“How are you going to make people your donkeys?”
"I will teach some (in my ways) and graduate them, then I will give them titles, and through those titles I will
make a group of people to ride on others. Therefore, when the Last Days approach, you will find my
graduates are riding on more than 99% of Mankind like donkeys!”
And the Seal of Prophets (s) advised, (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) "O my ummah! All nations are going
to be either a rider or a ride. O my nation! Don't be rides, but try to be riders.” Don't be donkeys, be lions!"
Can anyone ride a lion? But 21st century people are happy to be Shaytan's donkeys! Why are you not trying to
be lions, that will never allow someone to ride them? Everyone fears lions! That is the honor of Mankind. But
Shaytan did his worst for 21st century people and made the majority its donkeys. You now may find only a
handful of people who are created like lions; no one can approach to ride them!
O People! Now awliya are saying, why are you not going to be lions, why are you going to be donkeys?
Donkeys never give you honor, but to be a lion gives you honor. That is the last summary for people from
Heavens. O People! Don't be donkeys, be lions, and you will reach the highest level of Heavens! Otherwise, if
you are not lions, Shaytan will ride on you and you will go wherever it takes you! May Allah forgive us.
Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah.
Fatihah.

You never heard such a thing? It is an unchangeable situation now, everyone is riding not only one, but some
of them are taking two also. Some of them are riding on it and one also taking it from its tail. Allahu Akbar.
Fatihah.
(36 minutes) (797 viewers) Today is Jumu`ah. As-salaamu alaykum. Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani
'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
(Baya`)
